topic: Demo for the Government of Canada: Hs reads the COMPOSITION of Canada's entire open-data estate (open.canada.ca, 47,462 datasets) -- department/format/jurisdiction/collection shares, arrow of intent, effective dimension, concentration.
purpose: Smallest possible proof, on the government's OWN public data, that the compositional instrument sees what a dataset headcount cannot. Part of the Canada Division (GOVERNANCE stream).
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.
status: BUILT / DEMO -- one receipted read on real catalogue metadata (canada_open_data_composition.py, 209a8559). Descriptive, not political. No endorsement implied or sought.

specific_knowledge.what: open.canada.ca CKAN package_search facets (fetched 2026-06-24); total = 47,462 datasets. Each facet read as a composition: shares, arrow (dominant part), effective dimension (perplexity), HHI concentration.
key_points: Two mandates dominate: NRCan (10,247) + Statistics Canada (10,203) = 43% of all 47,462 datasets, from 2 of 100+ bodies; arrow of the estate = geoscience + national statistics.
Output does NOT track size: Yukon (pop ~45k) = 2,901 datasets, ~3x Ontario (988), far above its ~0.1% population share -- a mandate-and-culture signal, not a size signal.
Metadata-heavy: HTML (landing pages) = 29% of format tags; machine-readable core (CSV+XLSX+JSON+GEOJSON) smaller; catalogue larger than the directly-usable data within it.
Concentrated: effective dimension ~15 departments / ~11 formats / ~1.8 jurisdiction levels -- composition (not count) is the right lens. Receipt 209a8559.
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: T1 = engine + the receipted read; T2 = the government-demo framing; T3 = any value/uptake. Counts are real public metadata; interpretation is descriptive, not political.

next_step: Optional: extend to a second layer -- read one substantive Canadian open dataset's internal composition (e.g., energy mix, trade, GHG) and/or refresh the facet counts. Only descriptive output; governance + claim-tiers apply.
bring_your_own_ai: Start at README.md, then RESULTS_canada_open_data.md, then run canada_open_data_composition.py (numpy). Public data only; descriptive read; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001; instrument not data; honest-broker; descriptive not political; counts are real public open.canada.ca metadata; NO endorsement, partnership, or contact implied or sought -- Peter Higgins is the sole gate for all external steps; no AI commits/pushes/contacts.
